sources.note: openFDA drugsfda applications with an approval dated 20260809 to 20261117, filtered locally to the matching submission. Indication text is copied only when an openFDA label indications_and_usage field, or an EPC class, is present (22 labels matched).
Personal fields in the openFDA letter (representative, signatory, address) are not copied.
Monthly Orange Book zip. Headlines are NDA applications whose last unexpired listed protection falls within 75 days. Listed patents are not verified by FDA.

Changes section of October 2026 (https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/PurpleBook/2026/purplebook-search-October-data-download.csv). The full-database section of the file is not turned into headlines.
Meeting, amendment, postponement, and cancellation notices only. Nominations, renewals, and tobacco notices are dropped.
EMA daily medicines JSON. Variation decisions are not used; European Commission decision dates on already-authorised medicines are ignored. Source: European Medicines Agency.
Health Canada Notice of Compliance Database. Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada. Administrative and veterinary notices are dropped.

Europe PMC metadata, including MEDLINE records. PubMed E-utilities are not called: eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov robots.txt is Disallow: /. Queries cover phase 3 titles, a fixed high-impact journal list, and AI-in-biology titles. Titles that assert efficacy or effectiveness are skipped. Crawl-delay on ebi.ac.uk is respected.
Read-only use of calendar/calendar.json. The ClinicalTrials.gov API is not called, because robots.txt disallows /api/. Study-page links are used. This job does not write calendar files.

biorxiv details API, 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-17, 120 metadata rows scanned. Titles are linked to the preprint page. Abstracts are not copied. Category filter is bioinformatics, genomics, synthetic biology, systems biology, pharmacology, or bioengineering for bioRxiv, and clinical categories with a therapy or trial word for medRxiv, plus AI-method titles. Not peer-reviewed.

medrxiv details API, 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-17, 120 metadata rows scanned. Titles are linked to the preprint page. Abstracts are not copied. Category filter is bioinformatics, genomics, synthetic biology, systems biology, pharmacology, or bioengineering for bioRxiv, and clinical categories with a therapy or trial word for medRxiv, plus AI-method titles. Not peer-reviewed.

BioCatalystFeed Worker /papers, which proxies the Europe PMC search API. Same metadata terms as a direct Europe PMC call. Titles that assert efficacy are skipped. Duplicate DOIs collapse with the direct Europe PMC source.

BioCatalystFeed Worker /ai-discovery. Curated model cards are included only when verified_as_of or published falls in the last 45 days. arXiv rows come from the worker's allowlisted category query and are labeled as preprints. Summaries are not copied. No X client is called.

NIH RePORTER project search for titles matching gene therapy, cell therapy, monoclonal antibody, CRISPR, drug discovery with a project start from 2026-09-03 to 2026-11-17. Award amounts and activity codes are the API fields. Abstracts are not copied. The API is the public RePORTER service; project pages are linked.

SEC EDGAR daily index Form 8-K rows for 129 tickers already listed in calendar/calendar.json. 7 index days were not posted (403 or 404), which is how SEC answers for a weekend, a holiday, or a file that is not up yet. Requests use BioCatalystFeed contact@biocat.ai, per the SEC fair-access User-Agent rule, and stay on /files and /Archives (not /cgi-bin, which robots.txt disallows). The blurb uses the filing date, CIK, and accession number. Item text inside the filing is not summarized.

FDA press-release RSS. U.S. government work, published for syndication. Items are kept when the title or description names a drug, biologic, vaccine, trial, or related topic. The headline is the agency's title. The blurb adds the publication date and, when the description names a product before an outcome clause, that product text.
